attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: causal_p_8(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V, p(x) = sum_(r<=8) c_r x^r, learned c (per_head) initialized at 1/r!, then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain; head RMSNorm evaluated on each token and head's output divided by its largest magnitude, a constant to differentiation, with its epsilon divided by that magnitude's square (an output too small for that keeps its plain evaluation): the same function, with an FP32 gradient that is exact to rounding wherever FP32 holds the gradient itself (its elements are of size cotangent / output RMS, and FP32's normal range ends at 1.2e-38)
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <RoPE(g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps)), RoPE(g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps))> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero
